scope: P-192 and p1009 curves in research/cm_joint_s4_20261123; pure degree-five horizontal paths
statement: On the maximal-CM P-192 and p1009 source curves, the ramified norm-five ideal is nonprincipal; every pure horizontal degree-five closed path acts as an integer power of five up to sign, so the degree-five edge cannot supply an APS-E3-style noninteger same-curve orbit.
